drainage_flux.reason: Bucket and Richards soil-moisture solvers are alternative lower-boundary drainage closures.

evapotranspiration_flux.reason: Penman-Monteith and Priestley-Taylor should not be active simultaneously.

groundwater_storage.reason: GroundwaterDynamics and SubsurfaceRunoff are alternative shallow-groundwater storage closures; graph construction permits exactly one absolute-state writer.

gross_primary_productivity.reason: Farquhar and simple canopy photosynthesis are alternative providers of the canonical kg C m-2 s-1 gross carbon mass flux.

isoprene_emission.reason: MEGAN and mechanistic isoprene synthesis are compile-time alternative writers of the canonical mol m-2 s-1 isoprene emission port.

bvoc_carbon_allocation_flux.reason: The selected MEGAN, mechanistic isoprene, mechanistic stored-pool monoterpene, or reduced sesquiterpene closure is the sole writer of the canonical kg C m-2 s-1 plant-carbon allocation port.

nh4_nitrogen.reason: The NH4 SCM contract authorizes exactly four per-step ACCUMULATE writers: mineralization, nitrification, root uptake, and the NitrogenCycling fertilizer input port.

available_phosphorus.reason: The phosphorus SCM contract authorizes exactly the fertilization input and root-uptake output as per-step ACCUMULATE writers of the available phosphorus state.

no3_nitrogen.reason: The NO3 SCM contract authorizes exactly four per-step ACCUMULATE writers: nitrification, denitrification, leaching, and root uptake.

phenological_factor.reason: Static, GDD, GSI, and crop are the four compile-time-selected main phenology closures.

soil_moisture.reason: Bucket, hydrosphere Richards, and pedosphere Richards transport are compile-time alternative full-state soil-moisture closures.

surface_runoff_flux.reason: Surface runoff and bucket solver export overlapping runoff flux names.

no_mixing_ratio.reason: Gas-phase chemistry, eddy diffusion, and dry deposition contribute explicit NO state increments to one canonical ledger.

no2_mixing_ratio.reason: Gas-phase chemistry, eddy diffusion, and dry deposition contribute explicit NO2 state increments to one canonical ledger.

o3_mixing_ratio.reason: Gas-phase chemistry, eddy diffusion, and dry deposition contribute explicit O3 state increments to one canonical ledger.

isoprene_mixing_ratio.reason: Gas-phase chemistry and eddy diffusion contribute explicit isoprene state increments to one canonical ledger.

delta_residue_cover.reason: Harvest adds surface residue while tillage incorporation removes it; both are explicit dimensionless increments accumulated once by StateManager.

fast_som_c.reason: PoolsMatrix and FirstOrderDecomposition are alternative carbon-pool tendency closures; register exactly one decomposition model.

metabolic_litter_c.reason: PoolsMatrix, FirstOrderDecomposition, and MicrobialEnzymeDecomposition are alternative carbon-pool tendency closures.

monoterpenes_emission.reason: MEGAN and the mechanistic monoterpene synthesis functor are alternative monoterpene emission closures.

n2o_flux.reason: The N2O SCM contract authorizes exactly the additive nitrification and denitrification rate writers; gas transport owns only n2o_surface_flux.

nitrogen_leaching_flux.reason: NitrogenLeachingProcess and SoluteAdvectionDiffusion1D are alternative nitrate-export closures; register exactly one.

passive_som_c.reason: PoolsMatrix and FirstOrderDecomposition are alternative carbon-pool tendency closures; register exactly one decomposition model.

sesquiterpenes_emission.reason: MEGAN and the mechanistic sesquiterpene synthesis functor are alternative sesquiterpene emission closures.

slow_som_c.reason: PoolsMatrix and FirstOrderDecomposition are alternative carbon-pool tendency closures; register exactly one decomposition model.

structural_litter_c.reason: PoolsMatrix, FirstOrderDecomposition, and MicrobialEnzymeDecomposition are alternative carbon-pool tendency closures.

tracer_concentration.reason: Atmospheric and generic transport advection-diffusion tracers should be selected per domain configuration.

carbon_decomposition_rate.reason: PoolsMatrix and FirstOrderDecomposition are alternative gross carbon-decomposition rate closures; register exactly one decomposition model.

heterotrophic_respiration.reason: PoolsMatrix, FirstOrderDecomposition, and MicrobialEnzymeDecomposition are alternative heterotrophic-respiration closures; register exactly one decomposition model.

leaf_area_index.reason: Multiple phenology model implementations expose leaf area index and must be selected exclusively by configuration.

latent_heat_flux.reason: Penman-Monteith and Priestley-Taylor evapotranspiration are alternate latent heat flux providers.

phenology_phase.reason: Phenology phase outputs are shared by alternative phenology model implementations and should be configured as exclusive.

phenology_senescence_factor.reason: Static, GDD, GSI, and crop phenology are alternative absolute-state closures selected at graph construction; their dimensionless senescence factor must have exactly one active writer.

target_grid_fields.reason: ConservativeRemap and AutoRegridder are alternative writers for the logical target-grid field port.

regridded_data.reason: Bilinear and conservative regridders are alternative numerical closures for a regridding operation.
